points.quote: If you have not been given any other instructions, use this as the default category for your assessment and studying.
points.gist: Without other instructions, use Category 2 (minimal) as the default for assessment and studying.

points.quote: You can use AI tools for spelling and grammar check. You can use it for rewording occasional phrases, but not sentences, large parts of text or paragraphs.
points.gist: Category 2 allows AI spelling and grammar checks and rewording occasional phrases, but not sentences, large parts of text or paragraphs.

points.quote: You cannot use AI tools at all, including spelling and grammar checkers.
points.gist: In Category 1 you cannot use AI tools at all, including spelling and grammar checkers.

points.quote: If you use AI in other ways than what the lecturer says, it may be seen as contract cheating.
points.gist: Using AI in ways other than the lecturer says may be seen as contract cheating.

points.quote: Do not upload university-sensitive data into AI tools unless you have been given permission by academic staff.
points.gist: Do not upload university-sensitive data into AI tools unless academic staff have given permission.

points.quote: Translation tools may only be used for assessments if the assessment brief specifically allows it (for example, annotating or improving on an AI translation).
points.gist: Translation tools may only be used in assessments if the brief specifically allows it, for example annotating or improving an AI translation.

points.quote: However, you do not have to use AI tools in your work. You will not be given extra credit for using it.
points.gist: In Category 3 you do not have to use AI tools and will not get extra credit for using them.

points.quote: AI tools are needed for the assessment. You will be told which tools to use and in what capacity.
points.gist: In Category 4 AI tools are needed for the assessment and you will be told which tools to use and how.

points.quote: The use of AI during an assessment or studying will depend on the learning objectives, course and school.
points.gist: AI use in assessment or studying depends on the learning objectives, course and school.

points.quote: The library's AI guide helps you to critically reflect on the role of AI in academic research processes, such as finding literature and summarising texts.
points.anchor: How to use AI to study
points.gist: The library's AI guide helps you reflect critically on AI's role in research processes such as finding literature and summarising texts.
